description: This is a unit test class for the ClaimEventAPI, testing CRUD operations within the Claim API module of the OrangeHRM system. It extends a specialized test case class for endpoint integration testing and includes multiple data-driven test methods for create, get all, get one, update, and delete operations.

classes.name: ClaimEventAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ClaimEventAPI's CRUD endpoints within the OrangeHRM Claim module.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a claim event via the API, using data providers for multiple test cases.

methods.description: Provides test case data for testing the create method.
